Arno Breker (19 July 1900 – 13 February 1991) was a German sculptor who is best known for his public works in Nazi Germany , where he was endorsed by the authorities as the antithesis of degenerate art . He was made official state sculptor and exempted from military service. [ 1 ] One of his better known statues is Die Partei , representing the spirit of the Nazi Party , which flanked one side of the carriage entrance to Albert Speer 's new Reich Chancellery .
